card.name: Inside aspirin and ascorbic names
card.fires_on: The ending piece of the drug names aspirin ("in" after aspir) and ascorbic ("bic" after ascor). It appears in drug-interaction and dosing text.

modes.label: aspirin ending
modes.description: The "in" that completes aspirin, often in cautions about high-dose use with other drugs.
